title: Differentially Private Sparse Reward Estimation with Preference Feedback
abstract: arXiv:2610.30099v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Human Feedback (RLHF) has become a central paradigm for aligning Large Language Models with human values. However, the reliance on sensitive preference data necessitates rigorous differential privacy (DP) guarantees to prevent user information leakage. Existing private alignment methods typically assume dense reward parameterizations, resulting in estimation error bounds that scale polynomially with the ambient {model size $d$}. Such dependence is prohibitive in modern {overparameterized models} where $d$ is vast. In this work, we study \emph{Private Sparse RLHF} problem to address this limitation, assuming that human preferences (reward model) are governed by a subset of $s^* \ll d$ relevant features. translated_title: 基于偏好反馈的差分隐私稀疏奖励估计
translated_abstract: 基于人类反馈的强化学习已成为使大语言模型与人类价值观对齐的核心范式。然而，对敏感偏好数据的依赖要求提供严格的差分隐私（DP）保证，以防止用户信息泄露。现有的隐私对齐方法通常假设稠密的奖励参数化，导致估计误差界随环境模型维度 $d$ 呈多项式增长。这种依赖在现代过参数化模型中是难以承受的，因为 $d$ 非常庞大。在本工作中，我们研究了隐私稀疏RLHF问题以解决这一局限，假设人类偏好（奖励模型）由一个大小为 $s^* \ll d$ 的相关特征子集所主导。我们在Bradley-Terry-Luce模型下，提供了从成对偏好反馈中进行差分隐私稀疏奖励估计的首个全面理论框架，并引入了高效算法
tldr: 该论文首次在Bradley-Terry-Luce模型下为基于成对偏好反馈的差分隐私稀疏奖励估计建立了全面的理论框架，突破了现有隐私对齐方法误差界随模型维度多项式增长的瓶颈，使隐私保护的RLHF在过参数化大模型时代变得可行。
en_tdlr: This paper provides the first comprehensive theoretical framework for differentially private sparse reward estimation from pairwise preference feedback under the Bradley-Terry-Luce model, overcoming the prohibitive polynomial dependence on ambient model dimension in existing private alignment methods.
